jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling
jobs.description:
Construction Project Coordinator – Residential Remodeling

**Company:** Kitchen by Design Inc.  
**Location:** Pasadena, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site and Local Project Visits  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually, depending on experience  
**Experience:** 2–3 years preferred

About Kitchen by Design

Kitchen by Design is a family-owned general contracting and residential remodeling company based in Pasadena, California. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinetry, countertops, flooring, custom closets, and interior renovations.

As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Construction Project Coordinator to help manage our projects, support daily operations, and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Position Overview

The Construction Project Coordinator will work closely with company ownership, subcontractors, vendors, and homeowners to ensure remodeling projects are properly scheduled, organized, and completed efficiently.

This is a hands-on position that combines project coordination, field visits, material procurement, customer communication, and operational support.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is interested in developing a long-term career in residential construction and project management.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Coordination & Scheduling**

* Coordinate daily and weekly schedules for active remodeling projects.
* Communicate with subcontractors, installers, suppliers, and homeowners regarding upcoming work.
* Track project timelines, milestones, and outstanding tasks.
* Coordinate material deliveries and installation schedules.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and communicate potential delays.
* Assist management with maintaining organized and efficient project workflows.

**Customer Communication**

* Provide homeowners with regular project updates.
* Coordinate site visits, installation appointments, and project walkthroughs.
* Respond to routine customer questions and scheduling requests.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the remodeling process.
* Escalate significant concerns or project changes to management.

**Materials & Vendor Coordination**

* Track cabinetry, countertops, flooring, fixtures, hardware, and other project materials.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, lead times, availability, and deliveries.
* Assist with obtaining material quotes and coordinating purchase orders.
* Monitor deliveries and help resolve missing, damaged, or delayed materials.

**Field Visits & Measurements**

* Visit active job sites to document progress and identify outstanding items.
* Assist with field measurements for kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, countertops, closets, and other remodeling projects.
* Learn and follow the company's standardized measurement procedures.
* Prepare measurement notes, sketches, photographs, and site documentation.
* After appropriate training, perform routine site surveys and measurements independently, subject to required verification procedures.

**Project Documentation & JobTread**

* Maintain accurate project schedules, notes, tasks, and documentation in JobTread.
* Organize project photos, subcontractor information, material selections, and customer communications.
* Assist with tracking change-order requests and project expenses.
* Coordinate punch lists, warranty requests, and project closeout documentation.
* Help improve project templates, checklists, and internal workflows.

Operational Development & Additional Responsibilities

In addition to coordinating active remodeling projects, this position will support operational improvements and business development initiatives, particularly during periods of lower construction activity.

Responsibilities may include researching and developing relationships with new suppliers and vendors, identifying and screening qualified subcontractors, obtaining competitive material and labor pricing, assisting with estimating and proposal preparation, organizing showroom samples and product information, and conducting introductory outreach to local contractors, designers, and other potential trade partners.

The coordinator may also assist with documenting completed projects through photography and video, maintaining vendor and subcontractor databases, preparing upcoming projects, and improving internal processes.

These responsibilities are intended to help strengthen company operations, expand our professional network, and support long-term growth throughout the year.

Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, residential remodeling, or a related field preferred.
* Familiarity with residential construction processes, materials, and subcontractor scheduling.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating directly with homeowners, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Proficiency with computers, email, spreadsheets, and project management software.
* Experience with JobTread or similar construction management software is a plus.
* **Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.**
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to local project sites.
* Willingness to learn field measurements, estimating procedures, and other construction operations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should be able to coordinate routine project schedules, maintain accurate project documentation, communicate effectively with subcontractors and customers, assist with site surveys, and independently handle assigned operational responsibilities.

As the employee develops, they will have opportunities to assume greater responsibility for project execution, vendor coordination, and operational improvements.

jobs.description:
**About the Organization**

The Anti-Recidivism Coalition (ARC) works to end mass incarceration in California. To ensure our

communities are safe, healthy, and whole, ARC empowers formerly and currently incarcerated people to

thrive by providing a support network, comprehensive reentry services, and opportunities to advocate for

policy change. Through our grassroots policy advocacy, we are dedicated to transforming the criminal

justice system so that it is more just and equitable for all people. Learn more at: www.antirecidivism.org.

**Position Summary**

The Ride Home Program (RHP) Coordinator plays a pivotal role in the daily management and

administration of the Ride Home Program at the Anti-Recidivism Coalition. This position operates within

the ARC's member peer network, focusing on providing immediate reentry support to individuals

returning home from incarceration. The RHP Coordinator is responsible for facilitating rides home from

prison, ensuring a warm and supportive welcome upon release, and equipping participants with the

tools and resources necessary for a successful reintegration into society. This position also manages

transportation services for incoming residents of ARC's housing program.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Collaborate with institutions, counselors, and Probation Officers (PO) to assign and oversee the pick-up of recently released individuals through the Ride Home Program.
* Specific responsibilities include arranging accommodations and coordinating travel and transportation for individuals who have been newly released.
* In addition to assigning Ride Home drivers to pick-ups, provide local rides within scheduled shifts.
* Conduct thorough follow-up with recently released individuals who are participating in the Ride Home Program.
* Provide mentorship through regular communication and consultations.
* Facilitate connections to local reentry resources and support programs.
* Develop and maintain a tracking mechanism to demonstrate the Ride Home Program’s impact on reducing recidivism rates.
* Oversee the internal administration of the Ride Home Program at ARC. This includes processing travel reimbursements, monitoring Ride Home Program revenue and expenses, and developing and tracking program budgets.
* Collaborate with the Development department to actively contribute to the funding of the Ride Home Program.
* Support the follow-up with potential eligible members whose entry point was the Ride Home Program.

• As a valued member of the Member Services team, the RHP Coordinator may be called upon to assist the department in various additional tasks and initiatives.• Document Program participant application review and process them into case management system.

* Communicate with each participant Via institutional tablet or phone and verify all information provided.
* Schedule Monthly trainings for RHP Drivers.
* Assess RHP recipient reentry needs: Resources, housing, employment and or other support.
* Research, vet, and track resources for Members, including housing, Jobs, personal development, Drug treatment and education.
* Assist with reviewing and processing reimbursement forms from RHP Drivers including, log receipts, summary of drive, mileage, and photos.
* Work with our Communications Department to implement new ways to promote the RHP.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of one year of experience in case management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Knowledge of social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.
* Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to multitask effectively, or a willingness to learn and adapt to multitasking requirements.
* Possesses leadership characteristics and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Has a reliable vehicle and a valid driver's license.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as necessary.

**Salary/Benefits**

* Pay rate is $31.00 - $35.25 D.O.E.
* Medical, dental, vision benefits
* Employer-funded life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick leave

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

***Anti-Recidivism Coalition is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider employment qualified***

***applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance***

***Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.***

jobs.description:
**About Us**

The Office of the Los Angeles City Attorney is one of the nation's largest municipal law offices. With over 1,000 legal professionals, including 500 attorneys, the Office provides the City of Los Angeles (“City”) with the highest caliber of legal services, ranging from prosecuting criminal misdemeanors and playing a leading role in criminal justice reform to advising on homelessness initiatives, defending civil lawsuits and claims, and bringing civil enforcement actions in the name of the People of the State of California.

Guided by an overarching commitment to integrity, service and accountability, we find great meaning in the work we do and the services we provide.

We seek collaborative team players who understand that fulfilling our mission is key to making a positive impact.

**Description**
---------------

The Criminal Branch is responsible for the processing of misdemeanor cases filed throughout the City of Los Angeles. The Criminal Branch is seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented professional to support efforts to strengthen enforcement of Domestic Violence Restraining Orders (DVROs), with a specific focus on firearm relinquishment compliance. In addition to project-specific responsibilities, this position will perform administrative coordination duties, including data collection, report preparation, policy and procedure support, and internal operational improvements. The coordinator plays a key role in victim safety, systems coordination, public awareness, and ensuring efficient office and program administration.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

Under the direction and supervision of the Program Manager, the Administrative Coordinator I will act as Project Coordinator and will, for the term of the grant:

* Support interagency coordination between law enforcement, the City Attorney’s Office, Family Court, and DV service providers to ensure timely firearm relinquishment in DVRO cases.
* Track noncompliance findings, support law enforcement investigations, and facilitate legal follow-up.
* Collect data, prepare reports and correspondence, and conduct analyses related to DVRO enforcement, program activities, and administrative operations.
* Review DVRO noncompliance reports referred by the City Attorney’s Office and notify appropriate supervisors or case filers.
* Identify cases involving defendants with open criminal matters and coordinate follow-up.
* Collaborate with law enforcement to monitor firearm relinquishment progress and document outcomes.
* Provide referrals to the Victim Assistance Program (VAP) for impacted survivors.
* Assist with follow-up tasks, such as locating firearms, updating contact information for petitioners, and navigating proof of service requirements.
* Support a pilot project tracking DVRO filings at Stanley Mosk Courthouse, identifying cases involving firearms or ammunition for further legal/advocacy action.
* Flag cases lacking proof of compliance for continued monitoring.
* Contribute to the design and rollout of an outreach campaign focused on DVRO rights, resources, and firearm safety.
* Assist in planning stakeholder trainings, community presentations, and other public education events.
* Participate in monthly DVRO Enforcement Task Force and stakeholder meetings to share updates and discuss case-level challenges.
* The duties are subject to change based on operational needs during or following the term of grant.

**Requirements**
----------------

At least one year of full-time professional experience performing duties and responsibilities related to the Administrative Coordinator I position. Additional requirements include:

* Experience working in domestic violence advocacy, legal services, or systems coordination required.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with multidisciplinary partners, including attorneys, law enforcement, and community organizations.
* Knowledge of DVRO processes, firearm relinquishment laws, and trauma-informed, victim-centered practices is highly desirable.
* Excellent organizational skills, writing ability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
* Proficiency in the operation of personal computers, including maintaining databases and spreadsheets. Applicants must be proficient in MS Excel, including analysis of data in Excel.
* Initiative, ability to exercise independent judgment, and works well under pressure and deadlines with minimal amount of supervision.
* Ability to work closely with the public and external agencies.
* Participation in monthly interagency meetings, routine communication with stakeholders, and timely preparation of reports and recommendations to management.

Desirable Qualifications

* Spanish-speaking preferred.

Requirements for Application

* Resume
* Cover Letter,
* One writing sample, personally composed by the applicant in a professional or academic setting in the last year.

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

**Retirement Benefits:**

Employees participate in the Los Angeles City Employees’ Retirement System (LACERS), which includes mandatory employee pension contributions through payroll deduction. The City also contributes toward the employee’s retirement benefit. Contribution rates are established by the applicable retirement system an may vary based on employee classification, membership status, and other factors. For more information, please visit: https://www.lacers.org/

  

**Current Location**

City Hall East, 200 N. Main Street, Los Angeles. Position is subject to assignment at any location of the Office of the Los Angeles City Attorney.

This position requires regular onsite work. Employer-provided parking is limited and may not be available for this classification. **CURATE GROUP**

**Role:** Event Operations Manager, Lumos Experiences

**Reports to**: Head of Regional Events, Los Angeles

**Contract Type**: Full time 3:2

**Office Location:** Los Angeles area

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Curate Group is a dynamic events and experiences company, creating unforgettable moments that bring people together. We specialize in unique, high-quality live events - from large scale festivals, immersive concerts, cultural experiences and corporate events partnering with some of the world’s most exciting brands.

One of our core event brands, Lumos Experiences, is one of the most distinctive live entertainment concepts, creating atmospheric candlelit concerts that transform unexpected spaces into something genuinely magical. We're growing fast, running multiple shows per week across new cities and countries and we're looking for a highly organized **Event Operations Manager** to support the ongoing running of our shows.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Lumos is scaling rapidly across Los Angeles and we're looking for an experienced **Event Operations Manager** to lead the successful delivery of our live events. You'll own operational planning and execution across multiple venues, ensuring every show runs smoothly, safely and consistently while supporting the continued growth of the business.

This role suits someone who takes real pride in their work and spots what needs doing before being asked. You'll be a proactive problem-solver who thrives on responsibility, makes confident decisions and brings both energy and precision to everything you do. This isn't a role for someone who waits to be directed, it's for someone who leads, cares and makes things happen.

You'll also spend time at some of the shows because the best operations leaders stay close to the experience they're delivering. Seeing your events firsthand allows you to coach teams, identify improvements and continually raise standards across the region.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE**

Success in this role will be measured through event quality, operational consistency, staffing performance, wise budget management, positive guest feedback and the ability to support the region's continued growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **End-to-End Event Operations:** Own the full operational delivery of our shows across Los Angeles and surrounding regions, from pre-show planning and venue coordination to on-the-ground execution and post-event review, ensuring every event runs smoothly, on-brand and to a high standard.
* **Venue Management:** Maintain a detailed venue catalogue with layouts, access and contact information. Liaise with venues to develop event operations plans, venue advance sheets, emergency procedures and safety documentation as required.
* **Staff Recruitment, Scheduling & Training:** Lead weekend team recruitment, onboarding and ongoing training for Event Managers and Assistants. Manage and maintain up-to-date training resources, playbooks and manager toolkits.
* **Musician &** **Production Coordination:** Work with the Musician Booker to ensure artists are well-briefed and supported. Oversee production teams to ensure all technical and operational elements are executed seamlessly.
* **Processes & Operational Standards:** Develop and standardize processes across all shows to drive consistency, reduce ambiguity and improve efficiency.
* **Budget & Inventory Management:** Manage inventory, storage locations, equipment maintenance and logistics to ensure events are properly resourced.
* **Field Presence & Quality Control:** Attend a minimum of two shows per month, with additional event attendance as needed during training, launches and peak periods (shows are Fridays and Saturdays).
* **Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Deliver post-event reports, analyze KPIs and customer feedback and proactively propose improvements to keep Lumos ahead of industry trends.
* **Special Event & Venue Preparation:** Coordinate venue-specific requirements including permits, vendor sourcing, local compliance requirements, and operational planning for unique or non-traditional event spaces.
* **Coordinate Venue Insurance Requirements:** certificates of insurance (COIs), vendor documentation, permits and compliance records to ensure all events meet venue and local requirements.

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven experience in event operations, production or management. Ideally within the live entertainment or hospitality sectors.
* A natural self-starter who thrives on responsibility and momentum.
* Ability to motivate a team, set and uphold high standards and bring energy to your events.
* Confident in making decisions, even under pressure and always ready to find a solution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to multitask.
* Excellent negotiation, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Budget management experience.
* Driving license, traveling to various locations as needed.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, AI and team collaboration tools.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A competitive salary with flexibility based on your experience and skills.
* Access to our discretionary annual bonus of up to 20% based on personal and business performance
* Covered travel expenses to shows
* 11 days PTO plus federal holidays and extra gifted days off at Christmas
* An extra day of annual leave gifted for each year of service (up to an additional 3 days)
* Your birthday off (or a day within the same month)
* Health insurance
* 401k
* Maternity and paternity leave policy
* A flexible hybrid-working policy 3 days in the office and 2 at home or on-site where needed
* Significant opportunities for personal growth and career progression as the business scales.

**Manager:** Sr. Director, Head of Sales Operations & Activations

100 Thieves (“Hundred Thieves”) is the premier lifestyle brand and gaming organization. Founded in 2017 by Call of Duty World Champion and YouTube star Matthew "Nadeshot" Haag, 100 Thieves has championship-winning esports teams competing in Call of Duty, VALORANT, Apex Legends, and more. As a 100 Thieves' Partnerships Team member, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Partnerships team to ensure departmental goals are met. The Account Coordinator will provide administrative and logistical support to the activations team to ensure efficient operations and maintain strong client relationships. An ideal candidate will have prior administrative experience, be highly detail-oriented, and possess strong interpersonal and organizational skills.

**Requirements**

* 1-2+ years of experience in an account support, marketing, or partnerships role, preferably within the media, entertainment, or gaming industries.
* Must be located in Los Angeles or surrounding areas, with the ability to work from the Culver City office two times a week.
* Understanding of digital media and branded content partnerships.
* An entrepreneurially minded self-starter with competitive drive, initiative, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational skills and an eye for detail: you’re the type who color-codes your calendar and never misses a deadline.
* Desire to work at a fast-growing and fast-paced startup.
* Must be able to communicate confidently, effectively, concisely, persuasively, and articulately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft tools, Google Workspace, and familiarity with project management tools.

**Bonus Points If You:**

* Have experience supporting paid media campaigns on digital platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and X).
* Have experience working with or coordinating digital talent/influencers.
* Have supported branded content campaigns or video production.
* Are familiar with 100 Thieves' brand and community.
* Have knowledge of the gaming and esports industry.
* Have experience working on Slack, Excel, Claude, Google Suite products, Discord, and project management platforms such as JIRA.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist and support the Partnerships team in day-to-day operations.
* Provide campaign reporting, case studies, and manage brand lift study vendors.
* Support the management of paid media campaigns on digital platforms.
* Act as a liaison between internal departments (creative, production, content, social, etc.) to ensure all campaign assets and timelines are aligned.
* Help organize meetings, maintain project trackers, and manage deliverable timelines.
* Support on-site activations, shoots, or livestreams as needed.

**Why You’ll Love 100 Thieves**

* You will play a key role in defining the future of 100 Thieves and will be depended upon to ensure the success of the company
* You will have an opportunity to work every day with a team of smart, hungry, and humble gamers & entrepreneurs
* You will be a key leader in helping us reach our goal of being recognized as the lifestyle brand that took competitive gaming mainstream

**Job Description**

McKenna Labs is a full-service contract manufacturing company that specializes in hair, skin and body care products. We've been in the personal care development and manufacturing industry since 1998.

We are seeking an Account Coordinator to support Sales and customers by handling inquiries, processing orders, tracking shipments, resolving issues, and ensuring satisfaction by coordinating with internal teams on projects, orders, contracts, and delivery timelines. The position requires strong communication, problem-solving and detail-orientation skills to manage everything from initial quote to final delivery.

This position offers an exciting opportunity for individuals eager to develop their career in account management within a supportive professional environment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

* Request and review client required supporting documents and information for quote and project packets. Ensure documents are accurate and include all pertinent information.
* Process purchase orders, verify details (pricing, quantities, etc.), and enter them accurately in ERP system.
* Track/oversee progress of projects and orders. Monitor for accuracy of information and progress to ensure projects and orders remain on track and within customer expectations.
* Provide timely updates and proactively communicate with Account Management Manager regarding task progress, critical issues, variable date changes, and delays.
* Coordinate with internal departments (Sales, R&D, QC, Operations, etc.) to expedite orders, track shipments, and resolve discrepancies.
* Act as a contact for customers, answering questions via phone, email, etc., about products, order status, and delivery dates.
* Assist with troubleshooting requests from customers and internal stakeholders.
* Identify potential roadblocks related to budgets, resources, and timelines, and work together with Director of Product Development and Project Manager for solution.
* Provide support for multiple projects and prioritize workload in accordance with business goals.
* Perform responsibilities and tasks with an understanding of the importance of increasing accuracy and efficiency and decreasing waste and operational costs. Identify bottlenecks and offer suggestions on how to resolve them, including stepping in to perform any task in support of company goals.
* Maintain a positive and productive relationship with external and internal customers, co-workers, and others with whom the position may have contact.

**Requirements**

To fulfill requirements of job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High school diploma required. Minimum 2 years of experience in a role that provided support to internal or external customers, preferably in the areas of personal care, cosmetic, food, or nutraceutical manufacturing and packaging.
* Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to organize, handle, and prioritize multiple issues simultaneously.
* Strong ability to understand the needs and concerns of internal and external customers and respond effectively in a professional manner.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and be comfortable making suggestions based on limited information.
* Intermediate level proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Must be flexible to change shift and/or schedule due to changing business needs.
* Must be able to work in person onsite.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to handle or feel. The noise level in the work environment is generally quiet and may include shared workspace.

jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Nitrogen Express is a family-owned industrial and specialty gas distribution business. We supply businesses that need gases and related products to keep their operations running. We earn revenue by selling and delivering products and by keeping customers invoiced, collected, and serviced reliably.

**About the Position**

We need one accountable, in-office owner for the company’s day-to-day financial administration and office operating rhythm. The work is important to cash flow, vendor relationships, customer experience, and good decision-making. We want to replace fragmented processes with reliable systems—not just fill a desk.

This is a high-visibility seat in a stable, family-owned business where a capable person can make a real difference. The person will not be stuck doing one narrow transaction all day. They will own meaningful financial workflows, work directly with the owner, improve how the business operates, and build systems that matter. It is an excellent opportunity for someone who is tired of being buried in a large company or limited to a narrow AP/AR silo and wants broader responsibility.

**Responsibilities**

This person should own the day-to-day financial workflows for a small operating business, with appropriate owner review and approval on major decisions and payments.

* Maintain clean, timely QuickBooks Online records and supporting documentation.
* Drive invoicing promptly and accurately; identify missing information before it creates a billing delay.
* Own the accounts-receivable rhythm: aging review, professional customer follow-up, notes, escalation, and collections follow-through.
* Organize accounts payable: receive and code bills, maintain vendor files, prepare a clear weekly payables list, and make sure nothing important is missed. Owner approval remains required for payments.
* Support bank and credit-card reconciliations, month-end readiness, and clear financial reporting for the owner and outside accounting support.
* Create, document, and maintain practical SOPs for invoicing, collections, payables, customer account setup, and file management.
* Use Excel, QuickBooks, and secure AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to reduce manual work, catch errors, create follow-up drafts, improve reporting, and make processes more reliable.
* Serve as a dependable, professional in-office point of contact for customers, vendors, and the team.

**First 30 / 60 / 90 days**

* Learn the business, customer/payment cycles, QuickBooks structure, vendors, and current workflow.
* Take control of the AR aging and open-payables visibility.
* Identify immediate invoicing, collections, and file-organization gaps.
* Establish a weekly owner-facing cash, receivables, and payables rhythm.

* Implement a consistent invoice-to-collection process and documented collection cadence.
* Clean up vendor, customer, and supporting-document workflows.
* Create clear SOPs for the highest-risk recurring tasks.
* Present the first practical automation / process-improvement recommendations.

* Deliver reliable recurring reporting to the owner.
* Show improved visibility into AR aging, invoicing status, and upcoming payables.
* Complete at least two meaningful workflow improvements that reduce manual rework or missed follow-up.
* Deliver a prioritized next-step plan for stronger controls, reporting, and sensible use of AI.

**What success looks like**

* Success is not just “the books are entered.” The right person makes the financial side of the business feel organized, current, and visible. Invoices go out on time, collections are handled professionally and consistently, vendor obligations are clear, records are easy to find, and the owner can see what needs attention without chasing information.

Qualifications

* At least 3 years of relevant hands-on accounting/finance-office experience.
* Recent hands-on experience with QuickBooks and the end-to-end cycle of invoicing, AR/collections, AP, vendor bills, and financial organization—not only one narrow task in a large department.
* QuickBooks Online, Excel, bank/credit-card reconciliation, billing, receivables, collections, payables, and basic reporting.
* Experience in a small owner-led B2B business such as distribution, industrial supply, logistics, field service, construction supply, equipment rental/repair, manufacturing support, or a similar operational environment.
* A practical, privacy-conscious use of AI and automation. The candidate should be able to name specific workflows improved with AI or automation and explain how they protected customer and financial information.
* Comfortable making courteous but firm collections calls and documenting commitments.
* A demonstrated record of identifying a problem, creating a usable process, following through, and communicating clearly with an owner, customers, vendors, and teammates.
* The person must want to work in the office five days per week and have a realistic commute.

No CPA or bachelor’s degree is required if the person can demonstrate the actual skills, judgment, and ownership required for the job. A bookkeeping or QuickBooks certification is a plus, not a substitute for proven work.

Compensation and Benefits

* $52,000–$58,000, depending on proven ownership of the full workflow and the ability to improve systems.

**Field Measurements & Site Surveys**

jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**

Full-Time | Non-Exempt

**Salary:** $60,000 - $70,000 Annually

**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Department:** Project Management

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator keeps MVE + Partners project teams organized and clients informed. This role runs the administrative backbone of our multifamily residential and mixed-use projects — preparing meeting agendas, taking and distributing minutes, tracking action items, and coordinating communication between our architects, clients, consultants, and contractors. The ideal candidate is highly organized, writes clearly, and is comfortable in fast-moving meetings where design and technical decisions get made. This is a strong entry point for someone interested in architecture, design, or construction project management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Meeting Management & Documentation**

* Prepare and distribute agendas for client, consultant, OAC (owner-architect-contractor), and internal design meetings
* Attend meetings in person and virtually; take accurate, concise minutes that capture decisions, open items, owners, and due dates
* Distribute minutes within 48 hours and maintain a running action-item log through project close
* Schedule meetings, book rooms, and manage calendars and invites for project teams

**Client & Team Coordination**

* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client and consultant communications, routing technical questions to the right team member
* Track deliverable deadlines and remind teams of upcoming milestones and submissions
* Coordinate document exchanges with clients, structural/MEP/civil/landscape consultants, and general contractors
* Support client presentations by assembling materials, printing sets, and managing logistics; occasional travel to client offices and project sites in Southern California

**Project Administration & Document Control**

* Maintain project files, contact lists, and directories in Egnyte according to firm standards
* Prepare transmittals and track RFIs, submittals, and permit or plan-check status in project logs
* Track agency submissions and plan-check comments with the project team
* Support the Project Manager with contracts, proposals, change-order and additional-services documentation

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in architecture, construction management, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 1-3 years of experience in project coordination, administrative support, or office operations, preferably at an architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate firm
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams
* Excellent written communication, with the ability to turn a fast-moving discussion into clear, accurate minutes
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple projects and deadlines
* Professional, confident communication with clients, consultants, and senior staff, and discretion with confidential project information

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with architectural project phases and terminology
* Exposure to multifamily residential, mixed-use, or residential development
* Experience with RFI, submittal, and document-control workflows
* Working knowledge of Bluebeam, Adobe Acrobat, or Autodesk; experience with AI note-taking tools is a plus

**What This Role Offers**

* A central role on project teams with direct exposure to clients, consultants, and the full architectural design and delivery process
* Close collaboration with project managers and principals at a firm with roughly 50 years of multifamily and mixed-use experience
* A foundation for growth into project management or studio operations roles
* Hybrid flexibility per firm policy

*MVE + Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

**Position Summary**

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the primary post-sales relationship owner for a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction, product adoption, retention, and long-term account growth while acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer relationship management skills with technical expertise, enabling them to effectively engage with IT leaders, technical stakeholders, system administrators, and business decision-makers. The CSM will proactively identify risks, drive issue resolution, coordinate cross-functional resources, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their technology investments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts.
* Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer executives, IT leadership, and operational stakeholders.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess customer satisfaction, usage trends, success metrics, and strategic objectives.
* Develop account success plans aligned with customer business goals.
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide the voice of the customer to product, engineering, support, and sales teams.

**Technical Customer Success**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for customer deployments, integrations, upgrades, and operational issues.
* Understand customer environments, workflows, infrastructure, and use cases.
* Provide guidance on best practices for solution adoption and optimization.
* Coordinate technical resources to address escalations, performance concerns, and deployment challenges.
* Translate complex technical concepts into business value for executive stakeholders.

**Customer Adoption & Retention**

* Drive successful onboarding and implementation activities.
* Develop adoption plans to maximize utilization of products, services, and support programs.
* Monitor customer health indicators and proactively address risks.
* Identify potential churn indicators and create mitigation strategies.
* Ensure achievement of customer success milestones and contractual obligations.

**Issue & Escalation Management**

* Lead cross-functional resolution efforts for customer issues.
* Coordinate activities across support, engineering, product management, service delivery, and sales teams.
* Provide timely communication during critical customer escalations.
* Track and report issue status through resolution.
* Ensure customer expectations are managed appropriately throughout the support lifecycle.

**Strategic Business Reviews**

* Prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
* Review operational performance, service metrics, adoption trends, and strategic initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvement and expanded value realization.
* Present recommendations to customer leadership teams.

**Revenue Expansion Support**

* Partner with Sales, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to identify expansion opportunities.
* Support renewal activities through demonstration of value and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for additional solutions, services, training, and support offerings.
* Provide subject matter expertise during customer planning discussions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or related customer-facing technology roles.
* Experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and technology deployments.
* Experience working with hardware, software, SaaS, cloud, networking, mobility, rugged computing, or enterprise technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting public sector, enterprise, federal, healthcare, utility, manufacturing, transportation, or public safety customers.

jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Global Fix Experience (GFX) is an AI-first organization operating at the intersection of Customer Experience, Product, and Engineering. We use AI to detect, qualify, correlate, and prioritize technical signals coming from customer support interactions at scale, allowing our specialists to focus human expertise where judgment, program design, and cross-functional leadership create the most value.  
  
Our Program Specialist team converts AI and operational learnings into projects, enablement, and systemic improvements that strengthen GFX performance and reduce unnecessary work. The team combines operational expertise, cross-functional leadership, and AI-enabled workflows to turn recurring signals into measurable inflow reduction, standardized operating models, and closed-loop process improvements.  
  
Success requires strong prioritization, stakeholder leadership, analytical problem-solving, and comfort with ambiguity. You will partner across global teams, challenge and operationalize AI capabilities, establish rigorous standards and quality frameworks, and use every operational finding not merely to patch the immediate gap, but to feed learnings back into Knowledge Bases, TSGs, escalation logic, and automation to sustainably eliminate avoidable work.  
  
As a GFX Program Specialist IV, you will own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and governance of Improve Prevention programs across Fix Experience. Translate AI-generated signals and operational investigation findings into targeted cross-functional projects, robust standards, and closed-loop enablement that eliminate avoidable defects, elevate frontline readiness, optimize automation, and sustainably drive down contact inflow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* **Improve Prevention Ownership:** Prioritize recurring avoidable and reducible issue themes surfaced by AI and operational investigations.
* **Cross-Functional Action Translation:** Translate diagnostic themes into clear, concrete action items and roadmaps for Knowledge, Support Operations, Vendor Management, Policy, Product, and Engineering teams.
* **Program Execution & Stakeholder Accountability:** Lead end-to-end project execution, establish program controls, manage dependencies, and hold cross-functional partners accountable for upstream defect remediation.
* **Inflow Reduction & Measurement:** Establish baseline metrics and rigorous measurement frameworks to quantify whether process and product interventions sustainably reduce inflow, prevent repeat contacts, and improve CX.
* **Closed-Loop Systemic Enablement:** Feed prevention learnings directly back into Knowledge Bases (KB), Troubleshooting Guides (TSG), escalation logic, frontline automations, and AI models.
* **Operational Standards & Governance:** Define escalation workflows, operating standards, quality frameworks, and control mechanisms to ensure consistent operational execution across global sites.
* **AI Operationalization & Change Management:** Operationalize new AI-enabled workflows and analytical tools, establish adoption plans, run agent enablement, and ensure new operating methods stick.

* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional projects, continuous improvement programs, or technical operations initiatives.

**Job Summary**

The Program Coordinator leads day-to-day planning, implementation, and documentation of Eden Youth’s integrated youth substance use prevention portfolio, including scheduling and partnerships with districts and school sites. Current programs include Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, Stanford REACH Lab prevention curricula (such as Smart Talk, opioid/fentanyl awareness, Our Healthy Futures, and age-appropriate vape-free education), and the Familia Adelante curriculum and family workshops. The Coordinator aligns program delivery with school calendars, grant requirements, evaluation protocols, and the Senior Program Manager’s priorities, and incorporates youth voice throughout. The position also supervises, trains, and coaches facilitators and peer educators. This is a prevention role; it does not provide substance use disorder diagnosis or clinical treatment.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

**School partnerships and implementation**

Serve as the primary liaison between schools, districts, staff, and community partners to coordinate program planning, approvals, scheduling, referrals, and implementation. Ensure culturally responsive, age-appropriate, and accessible services across middle and high schools, including seasonal programming. Maintain site trackers to monitor attendance, program delivery, evaluations, staffing, challenges, and follow-up actions while supporting partnership agreements and renewals.

**Stanford REACH Lab curricula and appropriate intervention**

Coordinate the effective delivery of Stanford REACH Lab substance-use prevention curricula, including cannabis, vaping, opioid/fentanyl awareness, and alternatives to suspension. Schedule and support trained educators, monitor curriculum fidelity, and address implementation concerns. Collaborate with school teams to manage referrals, ensure confidential student support, and coordinate pre/post-surveys using approved Stanford data collection tools.

**Friday Night Live and youth leadership**

Coordinate Friday Night Live (FNL) chapters, youth leadership meetings, prevention campaigns, and school activities while promoting youth participation and ownership. Collaborate with the Youth Advisory Council (YAC) on youth-led projects, community outreach, and advocacy. Train and mentor youth leaders in communication, project planning, inclusive leadership, prevention messaging, and responsible reporting.

**Familia Adelante and caregiver engagement**

Coordinate culturally responsive Familia Adelante workshops and caregiver education in partnership with schools, families, and bilingual facilitators. Manage outreach, scheduling, translation and interpretation, registration, attendance, and follow-up while maintaining confidentiality. Ensure county-funded program requirements are met and documented separately from other funded activities.

**Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Health Connections**

Introduce ECM and Community Connect services to school counselors, family engagement staff, and student support teams. Identify potential referral opportunities for students and families experiencing complex health or social needs. Coordinate referrals to staff for Medi-Cal and CYBHI eligibility verification, assessment, and enrollment determination. Support connections to behavioral health services, and other community programs. Follow up on referral coordination while maintaining confidentiality and respecting family consent.

**Deliverables, evaluation, and contract compliance**

Maintain funder-specific work plans, documentation, and reporting to ensure contract compliance and prevent duplicate billing or reporting. Coordinate accurate data collection, timely submissions, evaluations, and quality assurance. Support county reporting deadlines, annual prevention planning, stakeholder feedback, and continuous program improvement. Collaborate with management and partners to fulfill prevention and youth engagement deliverables.

**Team coordination, safety, and professionalism**

Provide guidance, onboarding, and coaching to peer educators, youth specialists, and interns while collaborating with supervisors to support team development, staffing needs, and program effectiveness. Ensure compliance with mandated reporting, youth safety, district policies, confidentiality, and trauma-informed practices. Participate in required professional development to maintain program quality and professionalism.

**QUALIFICATIONS (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES)**

Strong organizational, coordination, and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, multiple school sites, and concurrent program deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with students, families, school personnel, staff, and community partners.

Exercises sound judgment, makes well-reasoned decisions, and develops practical solutions to operational and program-related challenges.

Demonstrates adaptability, embraces responsible organizational change, and supports continuous improvement in alignment with the organization's mission.

Maintains a results-oriented approach, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets established deadlines and performance expectations.

Demonstrates active listening, cultural humility, and respect for diverse perspectives while modeling inclusive and professional behavior.

Demonstrates accountability, ethical conduct, professionalism, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with at least two years coordinating youth, school-based, prevention, or community programs.

Position Overview:

**Now Hiring:** **Business Operations Manager, Hybrid (Rec Sports & Club and Academics)**

**Job Type:** Full-Time, Exempt  
 **Location: San Francisco, CA**  
 **Salary:** **$90k-$140k.**

**About Rocket Youth**

Rocket Youth owns and operates a growing portfolio of youth sports, enrichment, and after-school businesses across the United States. Our platform is intentionally multi-brand and multi-location, with each business maintaining its unique identity and local market focus.

We are highly acquisitive, completing approximately 10–15 acquisitions per year. Most of our companies are founder-led, with experienced local operators managing day-to-day operations.

Rocket Youth provides operational leadership and support services to improve performance and scale. These services span marketing, CRM, analytics, M&A/de-novo expansion, accounting, finance, HR, capital, and more.

**Summary:**

As Business Operations Manager, Club & Rec Sports and Accademics, you will play a **central role** in driving growth and performance within Rocket Youth’s Club division (currently comprised of Volleyball, Basketball, Lacrosse, and Soccer, and expanding into additional Club Sports verticals) and our Rec division (currently comprised of Gymnastics and Swim).

You will serve as an extension of the Club and Rec leadership teams, with the primary goal of profitably growing our businesses while offering strong operational support to our local partners.

This role is designed as a launchpad into full P&L ownership and general management of various partner-company P&Ls across both divisions. Successful candidates can expect to progress towards P&L ownership of multiple partner companies (mix of single- and multi-location operations) within 6-12 months, depending on performance and business needs.

This is an exceptional opportunity for someone hungry to learn, excited to apply or develop their operational, financial, and analytical muscle, and motivated by a long-term path into leadership within a fast-growing national company.

* Life and disability insurance.
* Employee discounts.

* Support operators in growing enrollment, participation, and revenue while maintaining strong customer experience.

* Leverage reporting and dashboards to track:
* + Enrollment, retention, and participation trends.
  + Conversion metrics.
  + Program performance and utilization.
* Translate insights into actionable recommendations for operators.
* Support pricing, staffing, and programming decisions with data.

* **Enrollment, Conversion & Retention (Rec Focus)**

* Understand and ultimately own performance across the full customer lifecycle:  
  lead generation inquiry trial enrollment retention reactivation.
* Partner with Marketing and operators to:
* + Improve speed-to-lead, follow-up consistency, and sales discipline.
  + Increase conversion rates from lead to trial and trial to enrollment.
  + Ensure marketing demand effectively translates into filled programs.
* Drive enrollment growth through improved class/program utilization and scheduling efficiency.
* Identify key drivers of churn and drop-off across programs and locations.
* Implement practical retention strategies, including:
* + Improved onboarding and early customer engagement.
  + Reactivation campaigns.
  + Cross-sell and upsell across programs and offerings.
* Continuously improve customer experience to increase lifetime value while maintaining program quality and safety.

* **Integration & Growth Support**

* Support onboarding of newly acquired businesses.
* Help assess current operations and identify growth opportunities.
* Assist in implementing Rocket Youth systems, tools, and processes.
* Enforce safety standards and compliance across businesses.
* Partner with integration and functional teams to ensure smooth transitions.

**What Success Looks Like**

You will be measured in your ability to:

* Build trust with partners across both the Club and Rec sides of the business and support them in day-to-day operations.
* Drive revenue and EBITDA growth
* + Revenue growth via a focus on enrollment vs. pricing, i.e., by improving retention, customer lifetime value, utilization, and more.

jobs.description:
**About Origami Robotics**

Join a small team building the platform that turns physical robot experience into better behavior. You’ll own a focused infrastructure project used by robotics and ML engineers, work on real systems, and ship something that lasts beyond the internship.

**About the Role**

As a Robot Operator, you'll work directly with our robotic platforms to produce the training data our models depend on.

You'll use guided control interfaces to move robots through defined task sequences. Each demonstration you record becomes training signal, so how cleanly you execute translates directly into model quality.You'll run repeatable workflows, hold a consistent quality bar across long sessions, and help us make the collection process more reliable over time.

**In This Role, You'll**

**Operate Robots & Collect Data**

* Run robotic systems through guided control interfaces
* Execute defined task sequences built for model training
* Perform repetitive manipulation work without drift in precision
* Hold a consistent quality standard across every demonstration
* Hit daily volume and data-quality targets

**Monitor Quality**

* Watch for irregular system behavior and escalate it early
* Review recorded sessions and catch problems before they reach the dataset
* Give engineering clear, specific feedback on what you observed
* Suggest workflow changes that improve throughput or reliability

**Set Up & Maintain Equipment**

* Help with workstation setup and calibration
* Handle basic mechanical adjustments and first-pass troubleshooting
* Keep work areas organized and safe
* Confirm systems are ready before each shift starts

This role involves extended standing, full use of both arms and hands, strong hand–eye coordination, and sustained attention to fine detail.

We're Looking For Candidates Who

* Have hands-on experience in a lab, shop, manufacturing, or technical environment
* Are comfortable working around physical systems and moving equipment
* Can repeat a task hundreds of times without losing precision
* Do well in structured, output-driven settings
* Own their own quality bar rather than waiting to be checked
* Speak up early when something looks wrong

**Nice to have**

* Prior work with robotic systems or human-in-the-loop interfaces
* Background in assembly, machining, lab work, or skilled trades
* Comfort with controllers, VR interfaces, or simulation tools

Driven by a passion for justice, inclusion, partnership, and excellence, our core values lead us to seek a broad range of perspectives and backgrounds to achieve our mission and maintain an inclusive environment where all staff are valued and respected.

The Executive Assistant provides executive administrative support to Development executives by managing schedules, facilitating workflow, supporting projects, meeting and event planning and coordination, and other critical administrative duties. jobs.description:
**About the Role**

**Location:** HQ - Williamsburg, Brooklyn

**Status:** Full-time/100% on-site

**Compensation:** $65,000-$75,000 annually

  

**Position Summary:**

Kith is seeking an IT Project & Operations Coordinator to support the execution of technology initiatives across our

retail, corporate, and e-commerce operations. This role sits at the intersection of project coordination and day-to-

day IT operations, with a strong emphasis on supporting new store openings and construction build-outs -

coordinating technology deployment timelines, vendors, and on-site readiness alongside the IT team. The ideal

candidate is organized, proactive, detail oriented, and comfortable working across construction schedules, vendor

relationships, and ticketing/operations systems in a fast-paced retail environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Store Construction & Rollout Coordination**

* Serve as the primary IT point of contact for new store openings and remodels, coordinating technology scope, timelines, and readiness from construction kickoff through opening.
* Partner with construction project managers, general contractors, and low-voltage/cabling vendors to schedule and track IT-related build-out milestones.
* Coordinate procurement and shipping of store IT hardware to align with construction and opening timelines.
* Track multiple concurrent projects (e.g., new openings, remodels) in a shared project tracker, flagging schedule risks and escalating blockers to the Director of IT.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-opening technology walkthroughs and punch-list resolution on-site or remotely.
Create/maintain documentation of store IT infrastructure standards, site-specific configurations, and lessons learned across openings.  

  

**IT Operations Support**

* Coordinate vendor relationships and purchase orders for hardware, networking, and telecom, in support of both retail and corporate needs.
* Assist with asset lifecycle tracking - procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement of IT equipment.
Help maintain internal documentation, knowledge base articles, and the roles & responsibilities resource hub.  

  

**Project & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Build and maintain project plans, status reports, and timelines for IT initiatives; run recurring status check-ins with stakeholders.
* Coordinate across IT, Construction, Facilities, Finance, and Operations departments to keep technology workstreams aligned with broader store and business goals and timelines.
Prepare status updates and summaries for IT leadership on active projects, risks, and dependencies.  

  

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, IT operations, or a similar role – IT, retail, and construction-adjacent experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating timelines across multiple projects with multiple stakeholders (vendors, contractors, internal teams).
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals strongly preferred, sufficient to coordinate with vendors and technicians - hands-on experience not required.
* Comfortable using ITSM/ticketing platforms, project trackers, and standard productivity tools (Google Workspace preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical timelines for non-technical stakeholders.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing deadlines.
* Excellent follow through skills and “stay-on-top” of things attitude.
Willingness to travel periodically to store locations for on-site coordination and openings.  

  

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project coordination training/certification.  

  

**WHO WE ARE**

Established in 2011 in New York City, Kith is a lifestyle brand and specialty retailer that offers seasonal collections of men’s, women’s and children’s apparel, accessories and footwear through a distinct lens of personal storytelling. Kith embodies a multi-faceted lifestyle, with uncompromising detail to fabrication and design. Led by Founder, CEO and Creative Director Ronnie Fieg, the brand is known globally for evoking nostalgia from a dynamic point of view, and working closely with a carefully selected set of best-in-class collaborators.

  

Kith operates 16 standalone boutiques around the world, and 3 shop-in-shops. Kith Treats, conceived from Fieg’s childhood love for cereal, operates in 10 locations, as well as Sadelle’s at Kith restaurants in Paris, Miami Design District, Toronto and Seoul.

  

The Kinnect Foundation, a non-profit established and operated by Kith, is a non-profit devoted to creating positive change through education, community and social impact.

**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

jobs.description:
**About Daysee**

Daysee is a new family photography studio in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, founded by two local moms who believe family photography should feel beautiful, natural, and genuinely fun.

We're building something a little different. A modern photography studio with an editorial eye, a playful spirit, and a love for documenting the little moments that make family life special.

We're looking for a creative, social-media-native person to help bring the Daysee world to life online.

**The Role**

We're looking for someone who lives and breathes social media, has an exceptional visual eye, and knows how to create content that feels engaging, authentic, and worth following.

You'll work closely with our founders to help develop and execute our social content, create engaging Reels, curate our Instagram grid, and build relationships with our growing community.

We're particularly interested in someone with a background or strong interest in photography, creative direction, fashion, design, children and family brands, or editorial content.

Our goal is to make our social presence feel less like advertising and more like a visual journal of the people, stories, and moments that make Daysee special.

**What You'll Do**

* **Content Creation:** Create and edit engaging Instagram Reels, Stories, and posts using our professional photography and video content.
* **Grid Planning & Curation:** Help plan and maintain a beautiful, cohesive Instagram grid with a strong editorial aesthetic.
* **Community Engagement:** Build genuine relationships with our followers, local businesses, creators, and relevant NYC communities through thoughtful, proactive engagement.
* **Content Planning:** Help develop and manage a monthly content calendar, ensuring a consistent and thoughtful social presence.
* **Campaign Support:** Support creative planning and content execution for seasonal launches, studio events, collaborations, and promotions.
* **Creative Ideas:** Bring fresh ideas, emerging trends, storytelling concepts, and new content formats that feel relevant to our brand.
* **Performance Insights:** Track basic social performance and help identify what's resonating with our audience.

**Who We're Looking For**

* You're genuinely social-media-native and understand what makes content perform on Instagram and TikTok.
* You have a strong visual eye and appreciation for photography, composition, typography, and editorial design.
* You're confident creating and editing short-form videos, particularly Instagram Reels.
* You're familiar with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Later, Planoly, or similar.
* You understand how to build organic engagement and genuine community connections.
* You're organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
* You're a strong communicator who can translate creative direction into polished content.
* You have experience creating content for a brand, creative business, or your own social channels.

**Bonus points if:**

* You have a background in photography, fashion, design, editorial, or another creative field.
* You're based in Brooklyn or NYC.
* You're a photographer or content creator yourself.
* You've helped grow an Instagram account organically.
* You have experience working with lifestyle, family, or hospitality brands.

Working With Us

This is a flexible, part-time role at $30 per hour, averaging approximately 7–8 hours per week.

You'll work closely with our founders on creative direction, with the opportunity to take ownership of social content execution, community engagement, and ongoing content planning.

We'll provide access to our professional photography, video footage, brand assets, and upcoming campaign plans. We're looking for someone who can take these materials and turn them into thoughtful, engaging content, while bringing their own ideas and creative perspective.

As a small, growing business, we value creativity, initiative, collaboration, and people who genuinely care about the work they put into the world.

How to Apply

We'd love to see your work! Please include:

* A short introduction about yourself and why Daysee interests you.
* Examples of Instagram accounts you've worked on or content you've created, especially Reels.
* A portfolio or examples of your creative work, if available.
* One creative idea you'd love to bring to Daysee's Instagram.

We're much more interested in your creative eye, initiative, and understanding of social media than formal qualifications.

**Website:** www.dayseestudio.com  
**Instagram:** @dayseestudio

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 5.0 – 10.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please share your social media work you are most proud of (it could be an account, campaign or post that did really well) and explain why it worked. Any extra thoughts on how you would be the right fit for Daysee is also welcome.

Work Location: In person

**Job Description:**

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.

**About the Role**

Page Six is seeking a sharp, reality TV-obsessed social content & community manager to join its fast-paced team, with a dedicated focus on its growing reality TV vertical, *Virtual Reali-Tea* . This role is for someone who doesn’t just watch reality TV, they live it! You know the casts, the feuds, the timelines, and the fan theories as they unfold in real time. If your group chats rely on you for every reality TV update, then this is your role.

**Key Responsibilities**

Collaborate with the *Virtual Reali-Tea* social and editorial teams to ideate and execute platform-specific content that drives engagement, fuels growth and leads the conversation.

* Pitch, conceptualize and produce timely content for maximum reach across social platforms, from breaking news to viral moments and deeper cultural takes
* Monitor social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Threads, etc) to identify trending conversations, fan theories, and emerging storylines and rapidly turn breaking moments into social explainers
* Help build the *Virtual Reali-Tea* voice and brand across social platforms by responding to comments, direct messages, etc., and engaging with our reality TV community
* Work closely with hosts Danny Murphy and Evan Real to identify the most compelling angles from interviews and quickly turn them into multi-media formats and pitch to other outlets for coverage
* Prepare questions for and cover red carpets and premieres ensuring we get the most news-worthy and entertaining interviews, stories and video to advance our coverage
* Appear on camera, when needed, to deliver commentary, explainers or quick-hit reactions to breaking reality TV moments
* Collaborate with online, video and social teams to ensure content is platform-native and built for shareability
* Write trending articles and video scripts with clean copy in the *VRT* voice when needed

**Who You Are**

* Deeply knowledgeable and genuinely obsessed with reality TV across networks and streamers (Bravo, Netflix, Peacock, etc.)
* Chronically online in the best way, you instinctively know what’s trending and why
* An exceptionally strong multimedia storyteller and producer who can match *VRT’s* unique voice, and create viral visuals and commentary that travels across the *Page Six* network
* Think about shareability first. You instinctively see the clip, the hook and the moment that drives to the story
* Quick, accurate, and able to turn around clean copy and scripts on a tight deadline
* A creative thinker who can spot the headline and trends and stay ahead of the fandoms
* Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple editorial departments, including news, SEO, video and social teams

**Bonus Points**

* Past experience covering entertainment or celebrity news
* A network of sources and contacts across the reality TV universe including with publicists and talent

**Why This Role**

This is a chance to help shape the voice and growth of *Virtual Reali-Tea* , the leading destination for reality TV fans, while working at the most iconic brand in entertainment news.

***Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week*** .
