jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Digital Marketing Manager  
Hooman Khorasani, MD PLLC  
Manhattan, New York | Full-time, On-site

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base Salary: $90,000 – $110,000 annually (commensurate with experience)
* Bonus: Performance-tied annual bonus based on agreed-upon growth goals
* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k)
* Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

**About the Practice**  
Flatiron Dermatologic & Cosmetic Surgery Institute is a premium boutique practice led by Hooman Khorasani, MD, alongside Erik Peterson, MD. We provide top-tier skin cancer treatment—including Mohs surgery—reconstructive and surgical dermatology, and advanced cosmetic treatments. Trust, medical expertise, and respect for patient privacy guide everything we do.

**The Role**  
We are seeking an experienced, analytical Digital Marketing Manager to take complete ownership of our online ecosystem. You will optimize how patients discover us, present our physicians’ clinical expertise with authority, and drive qualified patient acquisitions. This role requires a self-directed professional who can audit our current digital footprint, identify opportunities for improvement, and execute a high-impact growth roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Growth Strategy & Budgeting: Build and execute a 12-month marketing roadmap. Oversee the budget, systematically tracking ROI to scale profitable channels.
* Patient Acquisition & Funnel Optimization: Manage external agency partners across SEO and Google Ads; establish clear KPIs and review performance against agreed-upon goals.
* Content Creation & Brand Integrity: Manage the editorial calendar across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and the website. Personally capture physician interviews, educational videos, procedure footage, and before-and-after photography on a regular weekly schedule. Produce basic short-form edits and coordinate more complex editing with external partners. Follow practice protocols for patient consent, HIPAA, and healthcare advertising, seeking guidance when needed.
* CRM & Patient Conversion: With the assistance of the front desk team, build and maintain lead-tracking and follow-up workflows in the practice CRM. Monitor unanswered inquiries and missed follow-up opportunities, coordinate timely responses with the front desk, and track prospective patients from inquiry through consultation and completed treatment.
* Analytics & ROI Reporting: Provide concise monthly reports covering marketing spend, qualified inquiries, consultation bookings, consultation-to-treatment conversion, completed treatments, cost per acquisition, and attributable revenue. Use these findings to recommend practical improvements.

**Qualifications**

**Essential:**

* 4+ years of digital marketing experience with demonstrated results, including at least 2 years managing budgets or external agencies.
* Proven track record of accelerating qualified patient inquiries or customer acquisitions.
* Advanced execution knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, and modern CMS platforms.
* Experience handling patient consent, privacy, and healthcare marketing requirements, including HIPAA and applicable New York advertising requirements, with sound judgment to seek guidance when needed.
* Hands-on experience filming and editing clinical or procedural content, with the ability to capture clear footage in a treatment-room setting. Must be comfortable working with raw surgical, dermatologic, and post-operative photos and videos while following patient consent and privacy protocols.
* Experience building CRM lead-tracking and follow-up workflows, monitoring conversion data, and collaborating with front-desk or patient coordination teams.
* Sound judgment, respect for patient confidentiality, a professional demeanor, and excellent written communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Direct experience in dermatology, plastic surgery, medical aesthetics, or premium service sectors.

**How to Apply**  
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter to . In your cover letter, describe one digital campaign you improved, including your specific contribution and measurable results, and the first three areas you would audit during your first 30 days. Include links to two short-form videos you helped create, explaining your role in filming and editing each. Share only public or appropriately authorized examples without confidential patient information.

*Hooman Khorasani, MD PLLC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

Pay: $90,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**First Batch–Digital Marketing Manager**

The First Batch wineries create magic for our guests every day, whether that's bringing a dream wedding to life, creating a delicious new dish to pair with our wine, or helping people discover a new passion on one of our winery tours. We do this with an approachable, warm, inclusive, down-to-earth attitude that reflects our passion for bringing traditional winemaking into urban centers, so people don't have to travel to experience the magic of winemaking.

We are looking for team members who care deeply about creating a friendly, warm experience for our guests and for each other. People who love food, wine and events, and who love to learn, share, and tell others about their stories and adventures.

**Position Summary**

The Digital Marketing Manager is primarily responsible for all digital advertising efforts. This includes not only the programming of paid digital advertising campaigns, but tracking their efficacy, analyzing data, preparing reports, building and optimizing landing pages, and ensuring website content is created and optimized to convert leads.

**Core Responsibilities**

Digital Advertising:

* Paid ad creation & management on platforms including but not limited to Google, Meta, Reddit, Bing.
* Collaborate with Creative Marketing Manager to ensure content and content deployment on organic channels aligns & supports paid strategies and to utilize any high performing organic content.
* Conduct paid search governance by conducting daily, weekly, and monthly audits of paid ads infrastructure, ensuring flawless tracking, clean campaign hierarchy, and optimal budget allocation.
* Mitigate against wasted spend by actively managing search term reports to identify, build, and maintain robust negative keyword lists, routinely reducing cost-per-acquisition (CPA).
* Optimize creative assets via routine audits and A/B testing ad creatives, copy variants, and asset extensions (sitelinks, images, promotions) to maximize click through rate, lead conversion, and quality scores.
* Monitor and guide Google’s smart bidding and performance max algorithms by auditing conversion signals, audience inputs, and target KPIs regularly.
* Ownership of all SEO & GEO efforts including ranking and citations.
* Responsible for tracking all platform changes including core updates, new features, and testing any new AI/Agentic tools.

Data, Analytics, and Strategic Forecasting:

* Maintain ongoing, deep analysis of campaign data; have a "finger on the pulse" of the advertising engine at all times to instantly catch anomalies or scale wins.
* Own the weekly update of the results dashboard (Google Sheets) and synthesize complex data into clear, actionable quarterly performance reports for the executive team.
* Champion data hygiene by routinely auditing conversion tracking, UTM tagging, and GA4 integration to ensure 100% accurate attribution.
* Translate raw metrics into a cohesive strategic approach for paid advertising, ensuring daily and weekly optimization tactics align with high- level business goals.
* Analyze historical performance data and market trends to feed into the annual marketing plan, establishing realistic KPIs and tactical roadmaps to hit company growth objectives.
* Formulate and execute a continuous A/B testing framework (for creative, copy, and landing pages), using performance data to foster a culture of constant optimization.

Website Landing Page & UX Optimization:

* Ensure Ad-to-Page alignment. Design, launch, and manage high-converting landing pages specifically tailored to paid ad campaigns, ensuring an intuitive user experience (UX) from click to conversion.
* Maximize quality score & ad rank by building landing pages optimized for Google’s core ranking factors—maximizing Relevance, Expected Click-Through Rate, and Landing Page Experience to lower Cost-Per-Click (CPC) and boost Ad Rank.
* Boost AI & Search Engine Readability. Partner with our web developers to structure website content, technical metadata, and on-page schema so it is effortlessly crawled, understood, and surfaced by Google’s AI search models and algorithms.
* Improve conversion rate optimization through running continuous A/B and multivariate tests on landing pages (testing headlines, layouts, form lengths, and CTAs) to systematically improve conversion rates.
* Monitor core web vitals & technical health by collaborating with our web developers to ensure landing pages load instantly, feature seamless mobile responsiveness, and meet Google’s stringent page-speed performance benchmarks.
* Ensure all new landing pages and web assets are properly instrumented with Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, and event-tracking pixels before launching campaigns.
* Create website content that meets EEAT standards & converts website visitors into leads.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in paid digital advertising across platforms like Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, and Reddit.
* Google Analytics and Google Ads certified
* High software literacy - the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new/different software systems such as website CMS, CRMs, Project Management software, AI tools, etc.
* Experience supporting a multi-faceted business model that includes multiple verticals
* Wine and hospitality experience desired but not required
* Experience working in Google Suite, especially Drive, Sheets and Docs
* Proficient in Excel
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present information clearly and concisely
* Accurate and consistent work with exceptional attention to detail
* Self-starter attitude, willingness and eagerness to learn
* Ability to confidently work autonomously and with varying levels of adaptability amidst changing priorities

**Essential Duties**

* Ability to travel amongst our three locations
* Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds
* Must be on property 1-2 days a week
* Frequent walking, standing, or moving between departments or

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

DoubleVerify is a leading software platform for digital media measurement, data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, publishers and digital ad platforms. DV’s technology platform provides advertisers with consistent and unbiased data and analytics that can be used to optimize the quality and return on their digital ad investments. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best in class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

DV's Commercial team is adding a Sales Development Representative to grow our share of the media budgets that matter most: the world's largest advertisers and the agencies that buy on their behalf. Sitting between Sales and Marketing, you'll generate qualified meetings and introduction opportunities for our Growth and Ignition (G&I) Mid-Market, New Business, and Performance teams.

Day to day, you'll work alongside Client Partners and Enterprise Sales Directors to map buying centers inside holding company agencies, independent agencies and brand-direct advertisers. From there, you'll open conversations about how DV's Media Effectiveness Platform helps them verify media quality, optimize performance and prove outcomes. You'll also own smaller services deals from first call to signed contract, so you'll close revenue, not only source it.

You have one to three years in a pipeline-generating or quota-carrying seat and want to move closer to the deal. Cold calls don't slow you down, you research before you reach out and you keep every conversation moving until it lands with the right seller. You're curious about how brands buy media and where brand suitability, fraud protection, attention and AI-driven optimization fit into that decision.

Success in this seat is measured by pipeline that converts: meetings that become opportunities, and opportunities that expand DV's presence within the accounts that set the direction of digital advertising. The role is designed as a path into a closing seat on the Commercial team.

This role is based at our NYC Global HQ, with an in-office requirement of at least [3] days per week.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Source Pipeline for Three Sales Teams:** Run outbound sequences by phone, email, LinkedIn and in person to generate qualified meetings and introduction opportunities for G&I Mid-Market, New Business, Performance and Strategic Accounts sellers.
* **Grow Within Current Clients:** Reach stakeholders beyond our existing point of contact at holding company, independent agency and brand-direct accounts, opening new business units and buying centers for DV.
* **Map the Account Before the First Call:** Research priority accounts to learn who owns media decisions, who influences them and which parts of the DV platform the client isn't using yet.
* **Work Hand in Hand with Client Partners and ESDs:** Align on target lists, tailor outreach to each account's media mix and priorities, and flag upsell and cross-sell openings for the account team.
* **Convert Marketing Demand:** Respond quickly to inbound leads from campaigns, webinars and events. Qualify each one and route strategic opportunities to the right Enterprise Sales Director.
* **Run Discovery Calls:** Lead first conversations that confirm need, budget owner and timing before you hand off or move to close.
* **Close Smaller Services Deals:** Take services opportunities from qualification through signature on your own.
* **Keep Salesforce Accurate and Report Results:** Log activity, qualification notes and opportunity stages in Salesforce, and share conversion and funnel results with Sales leadership each week.
* **Put AI to Work in Your Prospecting:** Use DV's sales and AI tools for account research and personalized outreach, and share what works with the wider sales development team.

**Who You Are**
---------------

  

* One to three years of experience in B2B sales, business development or lead generation, ideally in digital media, adtech or SaaS
* A track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline, qualification or quota targets
* Comfort with high-volume outbound, including cold calling, email prospecting and social selling
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales engagement tools, plus hands-on use of AI tools for research and personalization
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain how DV helps media and marketing buyers protect and improve their investment
* A process-oriented, data-driven approach to prospecting and account planning
* A team-first mindset and the ambition to grow into a closing role at DV
* Based in or willing to work from New York, NY

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $69,000 to $101,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

jobs.description:
**Entry Level Medical Sales Representative – Nationwide Travel | $73K Base + Bonus**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Skilled Wound Care  
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY (Field-Based, Extensive Overnight Travel: 4–5 Days per Week)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Entry Level  
**Salary:** $73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Bonus Potential  
**Industry:** Healthcare Sales | Medical Sales | Wound Care | Skilled Nursing & Long-Term Care

### **Launch Your Medical Sales Career With Paid Training and Mentorship**

Skilled Wound Care is hiring an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative (Business Development Associate) for a nationwide, field-based travel role. If you're a recent college graduate or early-career professional who wants to break into healthcare sales, this role gives you structured sales training, mentorship from senior sales leaders, and a clear path to a full closing role.

No medical sales experience required. We're looking for drive, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

At Skilled Wound Care, we don't just fill roles. We build partnerships, and our culture is the foundation of everything we do. You'll join a team that pushes each other to grow, shows up for one another, and shares in each other's wins. We work hard, we have fun doing it, and we believe a great culture isn't a perk. It's how we operate every day.

### **Why Start Your Healthcare Sales Career at Skilled Wound Care?**

* **Competitive entry-level pay:** a $73,000 base salary plus bonus potential that grows as you start closing accounts.
* **Mentorship from senior sales leaders:** you're never alone. Your challenges become our challenges, and your wins become our wins.
* **Clear career path:** we develop leaders from within, and many of our senior closers started right where you are.
* **Your voice matters:** your ideas carry weight, and you help build the vision, not just carry it out.
* **Integrity-first sales culture:** no shortcuts and no pressure tactics. We win the right way.
* **Full sales cycle exposure:** hands-on experience in B2B healthcare sales within the Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) industry.

### **What You'll Do as a Business Development Associate**

* **Prospecting and sales support:** learn and help with prospecting, outreach, lead generation, and relationship-building with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities nationwide, working alongside experienced closers.
* **Territory development:** help identify target accounts and learn how territory management and national market expansion strategy come together in the field.
* **Consultative and clinical value selling:** learn to explain the ROI of our physician-led wound care model to facility administrators, owners, and other decision-makers. Training and coaching are provided.
* **Relationship management:** build your own professional network with SNF staff, facility owners, and regional directors, mentored by senior team members.
* **Team collaboration:** share field insights, ask questions, and contribute to a team sales strategy that lifts everyone.

### **About the Travel: A True Road Warrior Role**

This is a **field-based medical sales role with extensive nationwide travel**. Expect to be on the road **4–5 days per week, including overnight stays**, visiting Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities in markets across the United States.

jobs.title: CRM and Email Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
Authority Brands Inc. is a leading provider of home services, building brands that support the success of our franchisees, as well as bettering the lives of the homeowners we serve and the people we employ.
  
  
The CRM & Email Marketing Analyst is a critical technical and campaign execution role within the Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), reporting directly to the Director of Customer Lifecycle. Sharing responsibility for a portfolio of 15 home trade service brands (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and specialty home services) across 1,100+ franchise locations, this role builds, automates, and optimizes multi-channel digital lifecycle marketing strategies.
  
Working side-by-side with Print & Direct Mail Analysts and the Loyalty Analyst, the CRM & Email Marketing Analyst serves as a hands-on operator for HubSpot Enterprise and integrated Field Service Management (FSM) systems (e.g., ServiceTitan). This role turns customer data, seasonal booking patterns, and behavioral triggers into hyper-targeted email and SMS campaigns that drive lead conversion, service reminders, customer win-backs, and cross-brand customer retention across all franchise territories.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Portfolio Campaign Execution & Automation: Build, deploy, and monitor automated lifecycle email and SMS workflows (e.g., lead nurture, post-service follow-ups, seasonal maintenance reminders, cross-sell sequences, and win-back drips) across assigned brands within the 15-brand portfolio.
* HubSpot Platform Operations & Data Governance: Support the ongoing enterprise rollout, migration, and daily operational administration of HubSpot; enforce list hygiene, data standardization, workflow logic, custom object tracking, and CAN-SPAM/CASL/TCPA compliance.
* FSM & CRM Data Integration: Maintain seamless data syncs between HubSpot, Service Titan and Field Service Management (FSM) platforms to ensure real-time triggers based on job completion, age of equipment, and membership status.
* Audience Segmentation & Hyper-Local Targeting: Architect dynamic customer segments based on geographical service zones, historical trade purchases, home attributes, engagement frequency, and seasonal service history to maximize campaign relevance and conversion.
* Omnichannel Coordination: Partner closely with Direct Mail Analysts to synchronize digital touchpoints with localized physical mailings (e.g., triggering automated email/SMS alerts to align with direct mail drop dates).
* A/B Testing & Channel Optimization: Design and execute continuous A/B testing plans across subject lines, send times, copy variations, dynamic personalization tokens, offer structures, and CTA buttons to optimize open rates, click-through rates (CTR), and booked jobs.
* Analytics & Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain campaign dashboards tracking delivery rates, engagement metrics, unsubscribe trends, and revenue attribution down to the local franchise level; communicate actionable optimization recommendations to the Director of Customer Lifecycle and Brand Leaders.

Success Measures (KPIs)
  

* Email & SMS Revenue Attribution: Achievement of repeat booked jobs, conversion targets, and return-on-ad-spend (ROAS) across automated lifecycle and broadcast digital campaigns.

#### **Role description**

As we establish our brand-new, state-of-the-art production facility in the United States, you will be a versatile and detail-oriented Administrative & Operations Coordinator, supporting the Head of Operations as one of the first foundational team members on the ground. In this cross-functional role, you will bridge Finance, People & Culture, and Office Operations by coordinating local administrative workflows, vendor invoicing, basic bookkeeping support, and recruitment administration. As the plant is built out and operations scale, you will help create the administrative backbone for the site and have the opportunity to grow towards a broader Office & Site Operations role.

#### **Your Mission**

* **Invoice & Expense Management** – Receive, review, and route local vendor and contractor invoices for approval.
* **Bookkeeping & Bill Pay** – Support local bill payment processing, purchase order tracking, and credit card reconciliation in coordination with the central finance team.
* **Vendor & Supplier Coordination** – Serve as the primary administrative contact for local suppliers, contractors, utility providers, and equipment vendors during the site build-out.
* **Recruitment Coordination** – Support People & Culture with local hiring efforts, including posting job descriptions, scheduling interviews, and conducting initial phone screens for hourly or site-level roles.
* **Onboarding & PEO Administration** – Coordinate new hire onboarding, gather documentation, and act as the local contact for our Professional Employer Organization HR and benefits administration.
* **Employee Records** – Maintain organized digital personnel files and support local compliance with workplace policies and record-keeping requirements.
* **Site Operations Setup** – Assist the Head of Production with site permits, office supply procurement, utility setup, facility logistics, mail and deliveries, meeting coordination, and internal communications.

#### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in administrative support, office coordination, bookkeeping, HR operations, or a comparable operational role.
* Detail-orientated and independent.
* Strong organizational skills, high discretion with sensitive financial and HR data, and a hands-on approach to solving problems.
* Ability to manage changing priorities while building structure in a new site environment.
* Business-level communication skills in English.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with accounts payable, invoice processing, purchase order tracking, or basic accounting principles.
* Basic understanding of HR processes, recruitment administration, onboarding, or candidate coordination.
* Experience in manufacturing, operations, industrial, or fast-growing corporate environments.
* Experience with accounting or ERP tools such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Business Central.
* Prior experience working with a Professional Employer Organization (e.g. ADP) and HRIS tools

#### **Why you'll love working here**

* **Growth Opportunity** – The opportunity to help build a major US facility from the ground up, with a direct pathway into a broader Office / Operations Manager role as the team grows.
* **Comprehensive Benefits** – Health, dental, vision, and retirement options provided through our PEO partnership.
* **Dynamic Environment** – A highly collaborative role bridging site leadership with global Finance and People & Culture teams.

#### **Our Process**

* Interview with the Global Director of People & Culture
* Interview with either the Global Finance Director or Global Director of Transformation Strategy

#### **About us**

At Arethia, we fuse our long-standing reputation with a continual push for progress. A rapidly expanding player in the flavour industry, Arethia specialises in delivering innovative taste solutions and co-creating products that consumers love. For more than 70 years, Arethia has been known for its close collaboration with customers and the highest quality standards. With over 350 employees spread across Germany, Switzerland, Dubai, and Indonesia, we aim to shape the future of flavours with a culture that values agility, transparency, and talent.

With more than 100 years of experience, Sika is a worldwide innovation and sustainability leader in the development and production of systems and products for commercial and residential construction, as well as the transportation, marine, automotive, and renewable energy manufacturing industries.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. Approximately 33,000 employees generated CHF 11.20 billion in sales in 2025.

At **Sika**, we don’t just manufacture products – we deliver complete systems that contractors, distributors, and specifiers trust. Our product lines include adhesives, grouts, levelers, membranes, and full system solutions for tile installation.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Endeavor is real-world enterprise AI.

AI models are improving faster than most companies can put them to work. Endeavor closes that gap.

We exist to secure American industrial leadership. AI is the largest advantage available to the companies that make, move, and defend things in this country, and most of them can't reach it alone. We close that distance — so their customers pay less, their people do work worth doing, and the companies themselves come out stronger than the competition abroad.

To do that, we build custom AI systems for companies in mission-critical industries — manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, defense, life sciences. Not software they rent from a vendor that doesn't understand their business. Systems they own, built inside their own stack, in production in weeks.

Operating Principles

* One team, one fight. Small companies fail for a hundred reasons. Being internally misaligned shouldn't be one of them. We think like owners of the whole business — the question is always how *we* win. We're fighting the world, not each other.
* Strong convictions, loosely held. Show up with a point of view and hold that view loosely enough that better evidence can move it. The best ideas come from candor and debate.
* Default to open. Our clients trust us with their hardest problems and we extend that same trust internally. Information here is open by default — data, context, the reasoning behind decisions — because you can't own an outcome you can only see half of.

The Role | Business Development Representative

As a Business Development Representative, you will identify and qualify new business opportunities, generate leads, and build relationships with potential clients. You will collaborate closely with the sales team to develop strategies, set up meetings, and ensure successful handoffs of qualified leads for closing. Your role will require consistent communication, client outreach, and an ability to effectively present and tailor solutions to fit client needs.

What We Require

* Genuine curiosity about the customer. You research the market, form a point of view, and bring it to the call instead of reciting a script.
* Comfort with a half-built playbook. Ours isn't finished. You'd rather help write it than wait for it, and you can move with 70% of the information and correct as you learn.
* Self-direction. You set your own pace, flag what's working and what isn't, and ask for help early instead of quietly stalling.
* A teammate people want on their accounts. You share what's working, take direct feedback without getting defensive, and make the AEs and marketers around you better.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.

Compensation: $70,000 base salary plus commission with an OTE of $100,000+.

Compensation Range: $70K

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Assistant Community Manager plays a critical operational and compliance leadership role, supporting the Community Manager in the administrative, financial, and physical management of the property. Serving as an intentional career pathway toward property leadership, this position holds primary accountability for recertification management and regulatory compliance while actively assisting with daily office operations, rent collection, leasing, and resident relations. The Assistant Community Manager ensures the property operates efficiently, meets all contractual and affordable housing guidelines, and upholds high standards of customer service and mission-driven housing stability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Compliance and Recertification [40%]**

* Own the resident recertification caseload, ensuring all annual and interim recertifications, gross rent changes, and unit transfers are completed accurately and within mandatory timeframes.
* Conduct applicant and participant interviews, gather third-party verifications, complete calculations, and prepare thorough, audit-ready compliance packages.
* Maintain compliance across all financing layers, including Section 42 (LIHTC), HUD, HOME, PBRA, Bonds, FHLB, and Section 811.
* Maintain electronic and physical resident files in strict adherence to data security, Fair Housing, ADA, and auditing standards.
* Coordinate directly with state housing finance agencies, compliance auditors, and third-party monitoring groups.

**Site Administration [30%]**

* Support the Community Manager with daily administrative workflows, serving as the acting manager in their absence.
* Assist with rent collections, daily bank deposits, ledger adjustments, and delinquent account follow-ups in accordance with local tenant laws.
* Draft and distribute general notices, lease violation notices, and legal documentation utilizing eviction-prevention and de-escalation strategies.
* Assist the Community Manager with accounts payable, invoice processing, and variance tracking.
* Maintain office organization, logs, reports, and administrative supply inventories.

**Resident Relations [15%]**

* Serve as an escalation point for resident disputes, lease violations, and complex inquiries routed from the front desk.
* Educate residents on lease terms, program obligations, and recertification deadlines.
* Partner collaboratively with on-site service providers to process reasonable accommodations and support resident retention.

**Leasing and Maintenance [15%]**

* Process housing applications, maintain the property waitlist, verify eligibility, and execute initial lease signings.
* Monitor the Yardi service request dashboard to track ticket aging, conduct QA on completed tickets, and manage the administrative workflow for unit turns alongside the maintenance team.
* Assist with move-in/move-out inspections, annual unit inspections, and monitoring unit turnover readiness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Deep knowledge of affordable housing policies, HUD guidelines, and LIHTC compliance procedures.
* Proficiency in Yardi Voyager (or equivalent property management software) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Strong organizational, mathematical, and analytical skills with rigorous attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with proven de-escalation ability.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of affordable housing property management experience, with direct experience processing recertifications.
* Valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and reliable transportation.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Tax Credit Certification (e.g., TCS, COS, HCCP, or BOS) or required within 120 days of hire.
* Prior experience with Permanent Supportive Housing (PSH) and vulnerable populations.
* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, or related field.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* Occasionally requires moving materials weighing up to 20 lbs.
* Unit and property inspections require walking, stair climbing, and general facility navigation.

**LOCATION AND TRAVEL**

* Based on-site at 5150 N. Northwest Highway, Chicago, IL 60630
* Schedule: Full-Time; non-exempt; Monday–Friday, plus weekends/holidays as needed
* Requires occasional travel for regional meetings, trainings, or emergent support at neighboring portfolio properties.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Salary: $24.00 - $28.00/hour, commensurate with experience

We believe in supporting the people who support our residents. Our benefits include:

* 11 days of paid vacation
* 12 paid company holidays
* 3 floating holidays

* Paid parental leave
* SIMPLE IRA with up to a 3% employer match

* Up to $5,250 annually for professional development and education assistance
* Opportunities for career growth within a mission-driven organization

As our company continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Construction Project Coordinator to help manage our projects, support daily operations, and contribute to the continued growth of our business.

Position Overview

The Construction Project Coordinator will work closely with company ownership, subcontractors, vendors, and homeowners to ensure remodeling projects are properly scheduled, organized, and completed efficiently.

This is a hands-on position that combines project coordination, field visits, material procurement, customer communication, and operational support.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is interested in developing a long-term career in residential construction and project management.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Coordination & Scheduling**

* Coordinate daily and weekly schedules for active remodeling projects.
* Communicate with subcontractors, installers, suppliers, and homeowners regarding upcoming work.
* Track project timelines, milestones, and outstanding tasks.
* Coordinate material deliveries and installation schedules.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and communicate potential delays.
* Assist management with maintaining organized and efficient project workflows.

**Customer Communication**

* Provide homeowners with regular project updates.
* Coordinate site visits, installation appointments, and project walkthroughs.
* Respond to routine customer questions and scheduling requests.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the remodeling process.
* Escalate significant concerns or project changes to management.

**Materials & Vendor Coordination**

* Track cabinetry, countertops, flooring, fixtures, hardware, and other project materials.
* Communicate with suppliers regarding pricing, lead times, availability, and deliveries.
* Assist with obtaining material quotes and coordinating purchase orders.
* Monitor deliveries and help resolve missing, damaged, or delayed materials.

**Field Visits & Measurements**

* Visit active job sites to document progress and identify outstanding items.
* Assist with field measurements for kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, countertops, closets, and other remodeling projects.
* Learn and follow the company's standardized measurement procedures.
* Prepare measurement notes, sketches, photographs, and site documentation.
* After appropriate training, perform routine site surveys and measurements independently, subject to required verification procedures.

**Project Documentation & JobTread**

* Maintain accurate project schedules, notes, tasks, and documentation in JobTread.
* Organize project photos, subcontractor information, material selections, and customer communications.
* Assist with tracking change-order requests and project expenses.
* Coordinate punch lists, warranty requests, and project closeout documentation.
* Help improve project templates, checklists, and internal workflows.

Operational Development & Additional Responsibilities

In addition to coordinating active remodeling projects, this position will support operational improvements and business development initiatives, particularly during periods of lower construction activity.

Responsibilities may include researching and developing relationships with new suppliers and vendors, identifying and screening qualified subcontractors, obtaining competitive material and labor pricing, assisting with estimating and proposal preparation, organizing showroom samples and product information, and conducting introductory outreach to local contractors, designers, and other potential trade partners.

The coordinator may also assist with documenting completed projects through photography and video, maintaining vendor and subcontractor databases, preparing upcoming projects, and improving internal processes.

These responsibilities are intended to help strengthen company operations, expand our professional network, and support long-term growth throughout the year.

Qualifications

* 2–3 years of experience in construction coordination, project administration, residential remodeling, or a related field preferred.
* Familiarity with residential construction processes, materials, and subcontractor scheduling.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable communicating directly with homeowners, vendors, and subcontractors.
* Proficiency with computers, email, spreadsheets, and project management software.
* Experience with JobTread or similar construction management software is a plus.
* **Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.**
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to local project sites.
* Willingness to learn field measurements, estimating procedures, and other construction operations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should be able to coordinate routine project schedules, maintain accurate project documentation, communicate effectively with subcontractors and customers, assist with site surveys, and independently handle assigned operational responsibilities.

As the employee develops, they will have opportunities to assume greater responsibility for project execution, vendor coordination, and operational improvements.

Kitchen by Design is a family-owned general contracting and residential remodeling company based in Pasadena, California. We specialize in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinetry, countertops, flooring, custom closets, and interior renovations.

As our business continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced, motivated, and highly organized Assistant Project Manager who can take ownership of daily project operations, coordinate multiple remodeling projects, and help improve the efficiency of our business.

The Assistant Project Manager will play a key role in overseeing the day-to-day execution of residential remodeling projects, working directly with company ownership, subcontractors, suppliers, and homeowners.

We are looking for someone who can independently manage schedules, coordinate trades, communicate with customers, identify potential problems, and keep projects moving forward without constant supervision.

The ideal candidate is proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility in a fast-paced, growing construction company.

**Project Management & Scheduling**

* Coordinate the daily execution of multiple residential remodeling projects.
* Develop, maintain, and update project schedules and timelines.
* Manage subcontractor sequencing and coordinate multiple construction trades.
* Monitor project milestones, deadlines, and material readiness.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts and proactively develop solutions.
* Conduct regular project site visits to monitor progress.
* Keep management informed of project status, risks, and outstanding decisions.

**Subcontractor & Vendor Management**

* Assist with obtaining competitive subcontractor bids and material pricing.

* Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned remodeling projects.
* Provide homeowners with consistent project updates.
* Manage customer expectations regarding schedules, deliveries, and construction progress.
* Address routine customer concerns professionally and proactively.
* Coordinate walkthroughs, inspections, and project completion activities.
* Escalate significant contractual, technical, or financial decisions to company ownership.

**Field Measurements & Site Surveys**

* Conduct site visits to evaluate existing project conditions.
* Learn and follow the company's standardized measurement and site documentation procedures.
* Perform field measurements for kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, countertops, closets, and other remodeling projects after appropriate training.
* Prepare detailed measurement sketches, photographs, and site condition reports.
* Identify potential installation conflicts, appliance clearance issues, and other field conditions.
* Coordinate final measurement verification and approvals before custom fabrication or material ordering.

* Coordinate material procurement, deliveries, and installation readiness.
* Communicate with vendors regarding product availability, pricing, and lead times.
* Track material orders and identify potential delays.
* Assist with preparing project budgets, cost estimates, and subcontractor bid comparisons.
* Monitor project expenses and identify potential cost overruns.
* Document change-order requests and coordinate approvals before additional work proceeds.
* Assist management in improving purchasing efficiency and project profitability.

* Conduct regular site walkthroughs to review workmanship and project progress.
* Identify incomplete or deficient work and coordinate necessary corrections.
* Maintain project punch lists and follow through on outstanding items.
* Coordinate warranty-related service requests.
* Assist with final inspections and customer walkthroughs.
* Ensure project documentation is complete before closeout.

new_jobs.description:
**The Company:**

Getac is comprised of a passionate team that takes pride in its tight-knit culture. We are committed to our employee fulfillment by providing a flexible work schedule, honoring achievements, and maintaining a supportive working environment. Getac strives to promote an inclusive culture to create a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities it serves. We are looking for growth mindset team members to help lead the way. We provide mobile rugged computing and video solutions, software, and cloud services to challenging work environments such as military, industrial, law enforcement, public safety, healthcare, and utility companies.

* We are a team full of employees that believe in by working together we win together.
* We offer a generous health care policy, PTO, and 401(K) with a 3% Contribution.
* We believe in making a difference every day.
* We offer performance- based bonuses.

**Position Summary**

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as the primary post-sales relationship owner for a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction, product adoption, retention, and long-term account growth while acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer relationship management skills with technical expertise, enabling them to effectively engage with IT leaders, technical stakeholders, system administrators, and business decision-makers. The CSM will proactively identify risks, drive issue resolution, coordinate cross-functional resources, and ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their technology investments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Manage a portfolio of 10-20 strategic enterprise accounts.
* Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with customer executives, IT leadership, and operational stakeholders.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess customer satisfaction, usage trends, success metrics, and strategic objectives.
* Develop account success plans aligned with customer business goals.
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide the voice of the customer to product, engineering, support, and sales teams.

**Technical Customer Success**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for customer deployments, integrations, upgrades, and operational issues.
* Understand customer environments, workflows, infrastructure, and use cases.
* Provide guidance on best practices for solution adoption and optimization.
* Coordinate technical resources to address escalations, performance concerns, and deployment challenges.
* Translate complex technical concepts into business value for executive stakeholders.

**Customer Adoption & Retention**

* Drive successful onboarding and implementation activities.
* Develop adoption plans to maximize utilization of products, services, and support programs.
* Monitor customer health indicators and proactively address risks.
* Identify potential churn indicators and create mitigation strategies.
* Ensure achievement of customer success milestones and contractual obligations.

**Issue & Escalation Management**

* Lead cross-functional resolution efforts for customer issues.
* Coordinate activities across support, engineering, product management, service delivery, and sales teams.
* Provide timely communication during critical customer escalations.
* Track and report issue status through resolution.
* Ensure customer expectations are managed appropriately throughout the support lifecycle.

**Strategic Business Reviews**

* Prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Executive Business Reviews (EBRs).
* Review operational performance, service metrics, adoption trends, and strategic initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvement and expanded value realization.
* Present recommendations to customer leadership teams.

**Revenue Expansion Support**

* Partner with Sales, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to identify expansion opportunities.
* Support renewal activities through demonstration of value and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for additional solutions, services, training, and support offerings.
* Provide subject matter expertise during customer planning discussions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or related customer-facing technology roles.
* Experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and technology deployments.
* Experience working with hardware, software, SaaS, cloud, networking, mobility, rugged computing, or enterprise technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer relationships simultaneously.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting public sector, enterprise, federal, healthcare, utility, manufacturing, transportation, or public safety customers.
* Understanding of enterprise device management, mobility solutions, operating systems, networking, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365, or similar systems.
* Technical certifications (CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, AWS, Azure, ITIL, etc.).
* Experience delivering executive-level business reviews.

new_jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Global Fix Experience (GFX) is an AI-first organization operating at the intersection of Customer Experience, Product, and Engineering. We use AI to detect, qualify, correlate, and prioritize technical signals coming from customer support interactions at scale, allowing our specialists to focus human expertise where judgment, program design, and cross-functional leadership create the most value.  
  
Our Program Specialist team converts AI and operational learnings into projects, enablement, and systemic improvements that strengthen GFX performance and reduce unnecessary work. The team combines operational expertise, cross-functional leadership, and AI-enabled workflows to turn recurring signals into measurable inflow reduction, standardized operating models, and closed-loop process improvements.  
  
Success requires strong prioritization, stakeholder leadership, analytical problem-solving, and comfort with ambiguity. You will partner across global teams, challenge and operationalize AI capabilities, establish rigorous standards and quality frameworks, and use every operational finding not merely to patch the immediate gap, but to feed learnings back into Knowledge Bases, TSGs, escalation logic, and automation to sustainably eliminate avoidable work.  
  
As a GFX Program Specialist IV, you will own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and governance of Improve Prevention programs across Fix Experience. Translate AI-generated signals and operational investigation findings into targeted cross-functional projects, robust standards, and closed-loop enablement that eliminate avoidable defects, elevate frontline readiness, optimize automation, and sustainably drive down contact inflow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* **Improve Prevention Ownership:** Prioritize recurring avoidable and reducible issue themes surfaced by AI and operational investigations.
* **Cross-Functional Action Translation:** Translate diagnostic themes into clear, concrete action items and roadmaps for Knowledge, Support Operations, Vendor Management, Policy, Product, and Engineering teams.
* **Program Execution & Stakeholder Accountability:** Lead end-to-end project execution, establish program controls, manage dependencies, and hold cross-functional partners accountable for upstream defect remediation.
* **Inflow Reduction & Measurement:** Establish baseline metrics and rigorous measurement frameworks to quantify whether process and product interventions sustainably reduce inflow, prevent repeat contacts, and improve CX.
* **Closed-Loop Systemic Enablement:** Feed prevention learnings directly back into Knowledge Bases (KB), Troubleshooting Guides (TSG), escalation logic, frontline automations, and AI models.
* **Operational Standards & Governance:** Define escalation workflows, operating standards, quality frameworks, and control mechanisms to ensure consistent operational execution across global sites.
* **AI Operationalization & Change Management:** Operationalize new AI-enabled workflows and analytical tools, establish adoption plans, run agent enablement, and ensure new operating methods stick.
* **Executive Communication:** Synthesize complex performance data, mitigation impact, and program statuses into high-level slide decks, executive narratives, and stakeholder reviews.

* At least 2 years of experience in project management or program operations in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment.
* Proficiency in advanced project management frameworks and global coordination tools.
* Proven proficiency in problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder management at a global or cross-site level.
* Advanced organizational, planning, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to connect project performance to business metrics.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional projects, continuous improvement programs, or technical operations initiatives.
* Proven track record of translating operational insights and data trends into actionable requirements for Product, ENG, Policy, or Operations partners.
* Demonstrated experience in project management: managing project lifecycles end-to-end, defining milestones, setting controls, and driving partner accountability.
* Practical experience operationalizing AI, automation, or data tools to streamline repetitive analysis and workflow execution.
* Experience designing operational standards, quality frameworks, or support workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.

We All Really Matter (W.A.R.M.) is a Harlem-based nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting women and families impacted by domestic violence. This role is for someone who doesn’t just watch reality TV, they live it! You know the casts, the feuds, the timelines, and the fan theories as they unfold in real time. * Pitch, conceptualize and produce timely content for maximum reach across social platforms, from breaking news to viral moments and deeper cultural takes
* Monitor social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Threads, etc) to identify trending conversations, fan theories, and emerging storylines and rapidly turn breaking moments into social explainers
* Help build the *Virtual Reali-Tea* voice and brand across social platforms by responding to comments, direct messages, etc., and engaging with our reality TV community

* Collaborate with online, video and social teams to ensure content is platform-native and built for shareability

**Who You Are**

* Deeply knowledgeable and genuinely obsessed with reality TV across networks and streamers (Bravo, Netflix, Peacock, etc.)
* Chronically online in the best way, you instinctively know what’s trending and why
* An exceptionally strong multimedia storyteller and producer who can match *VRT’s* unique voice, and create viral visuals and commentary that travels across the *Page Six* network
* Think about shareability first. You instinctively see the clip, the hook and the moment that drives to the story
* Quick, accurate, and able to turn around clean copy and scripts on a tight deadline
* A creative thinker who can spot the headline and trends and stay ahead of the fandoms
* Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple editorial departments, including news, SEO, video and social teams

**Bonus Points**

* Past experience covering entertainment or celebrity news
* A network of sources and contacts across the reality TV universe including with publicists and talent

Digital Marketing Manager  
Hooman Khorasani, MD PLLC  
Manhattan, New York | Full-time, On-site

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Base Salary: $90,000 – $110,000 annually (commensurate with experience)
* Bonus: Performance-tied annual bonus based on agreed-upon growth goals
* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* Retirement: 401(k)
* Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

**About the Practice**  
Flatiron Dermatologic & Cosmetic Surgery Institute is a premium boutique practice led by Hooman Khorasani, MD, alongside Erik Peterson, MD. We provide top-tier skin cancer treatment—including Mohs surgery—reconstructive and surgical dermatology, and advanced cosmetic treatments. Trust, medical expertise, and respect for patient privacy guide everything we do.

**The Role**  
We are seeking an experienced, analytical Digital Marketing Manager to take complete ownership of our online ecosystem. You will optimize how patients discover us, present our physicians’ clinical expertise with authority, and drive qualified patient acquisitions. This role requires a self-directed professional who can audit our current digital footprint, identify opportunities for improvement, and execute a high-impact growth roadmap.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Growth Strategy & Budgeting: Build and execute a 12-month marketing roadmap. Oversee the budget, systematically tracking ROI to scale profitable channels.
* Patient Acquisition & Funnel Optimization: Manage external agency partners across SEO and Google Ads; establish clear KPIs and review performance against agreed-upon goals.
* Content Creation & Brand Integrity: Manage the editorial calendar across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and the website. Personally capture physician interviews, educational videos, procedure footage, and before-and-after photography on a regular weekly schedule. Produce basic short-form edits and coordinate more complex editing with external partners. Follow practice protocols for patient consent, HIPAA, and healthcare advertising, seeking guidance when needed.
* CRM & Patient Conversion: With the assistance of the front desk team, build and maintain lead-tracking and follow-up workflows in the practice CRM. Monitor unanswered inquiries and missed follow-up opportunities, coordinate timely responses with the front desk, and track prospective patients from inquiry through consultation and completed treatment.
* Analytics & ROI Reporting: Provide concise monthly reports covering marketing spend, qualified inquiries, consultation bookings, consultation-to-treatment conversion, completed treatments, cost per acquisition, and attributable revenue. Use these findings to recommend practical improvements.

**Qualifications**

**Essential:**

* 4+ years of digital marketing experience with demonstrated results, including at least 2 years managing budgets or external agencies.
* Proven track record of accelerating qualified patient inquiries or customer acquisitions.
* Advanced execution knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Google Business Profile, and modern CMS platforms.
* Experience handling patient consent, privacy, and healthcare marketing requirements, including HIPAA and applicable New York advertising requirements, with sound judgment to seek guidance when needed.
* Hands-on experience filming and editing clinical or procedural content, with the ability to capture clear footage in a treatment-room setting. Must be comfortable working with raw surgical, dermatologic, and post-operative photos and videos while following patient consent and privacy protocols.
* Experience building CRM lead-tracking and follow-up workflows, monitoring conversion data, and collaborating with front-desk or patient coordination teams.
* Sound judgment, respect for patient confidentiality, a professional demeanor, and excellent written communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Direct experience in dermatology, plastic surgery, medical aesthetics, or premium service sectors.

**How to Apply**  
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter to . In your cover letter, describe one digital campaign you improved, including your specific contribution and measurable results, and the first three areas you would audit during your first 30 days. Include links to two short-form videos you helped create, explaining your role in filming and editing each. Share only public or appropriately authorized examples without confidential patient information.

*Hooman Khorasani, MD PLLC is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.*

new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

DoubleVerify is a leading software platform for digital media measurement, data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, publishers and digital ad platforms. DV’s technology platform provides advertisers with consistent and unbiased data and analytics that can be used to optimize the quality and return on their digital ad investments. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best in class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

DV's Commercial team is adding a Sales Development Representative to grow our share of the media budgets that matter most: the world's largest advertisers and the agencies that buy on their behalf. Sitting between Sales and Marketing, you'll generate qualified meetings and introduction opportunities for our Growth and Ignition (G&I) Mid-Market, New Business, and Performance teams.

Day to day, you'll work alongside Client Partners and Enterprise Sales Directors to map buying centers inside holding company agencies, independent agencies and brand-direct advertisers. From there, you'll open conversations about how DV's Media Effectiveness Platform helps them verify media quality, optimize performance and prove outcomes. You'll also own smaller services deals from first call to signed contract, so you'll close revenue, not only source it.

You have one to three years in a pipeline-generating or quota-carrying seat and want to move closer to the deal. Cold calls don't slow you down, you research before you reach out and you keep every conversation moving until it lands with the right seller. You're curious about how brands buy media and where brand suitability, fraud protection, attention and AI-driven optimization fit into that decision.

Success in this seat is measured by pipeline that converts: meetings that become opportunities, and opportunities that expand DV's presence within the accounts that set the direction of digital advertising. The role is designed as a path into a closing seat on the Commercial team.

This role is based at our NYC Global HQ, with an in-office requirement of at least [3] days per week.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Source Pipeline for Three Sales Teams:** Run outbound sequences by phone, email, LinkedIn and in person to generate qualified meetings and introduction opportunities for G&I Mid-Market, New Business, Performance and Strategic Accounts sellers.
* **Grow Within Current Clients:** Reach stakeholders beyond our existing point of contact at holding company, independent agency and brand-direct accounts, opening new business units and buying centers for DV.
* **Map the Account Before the First Call:** Research priority accounts to learn who owns media decisions, who influences them and which parts of the DV platform the client isn't using yet.
* **Work Hand in Hand with Client Partners and ESDs:** Align on target lists, tailor outreach to each account's media mix and priorities, and flag upsell and cross-sell openings for the account team.
* **Convert Marketing Demand:** Respond quickly to inbound leads from campaigns, webinars and events. Qualify each one and route strategic opportunities to the right Enterprise Sales Director.
* **Run Discovery Calls:** Lead first conversations that confirm need, budget owner and timing before you hand off or move to close.
* **Close Smaller Services Deals:** Take services opportunities from qualification through signature on your own.
* **Keep Salesforce Accurate and Report Results:** Log activity, qualification notes and opportunity stages in Salesforce, and share conversion and funnel results with Sales leadership each week.
* **Put AI to Work in Your Prospecting:** Use DV's sales and AI tools for account research and personalized outreach, and share what works with the wider sales development team.

**Who You Are**
---------------

  

* One to three years of experience in B2B sales, business development or lead generation, ideally in digital media, adtech or SaaS
* A track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline, qualification or quota targets
* Comfort with high-volume outbound, including cold calling, email prospecting and social selling
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales engagement tools, plus hands-on use of AI tools for research and personalization
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain how DV helps media and marketing buyers protect and improve their investment
* A process-oriented, data-driven approach to prospecting and account planning
* A team-first mindset and the ambition to grow into a closing role at DV
* Based in or willing to work from New York, NY

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between $69,000 to $101,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted.

Not-so-fun fact: Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of job criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes but you’re not sure that you check every box, apply anyway!

new_jobs.description:
**Entry Level Medical Sales Representative – Nationwide Travel | $73K Base + Bonus**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Skilled Wound Care  
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY (Field-Based, Extensive Overnight Travel: 4–5 Days per Week)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Entry Level  
**Salary:** $73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Bonus Potential  
**Industry:** Healthcare Sales | Medical Sales | Wound Care | Skilled Nursing & Long-Term Care

### **Launch Your Medical Sales Career With Paid Training and Mentorship**

Skilled Wound Care is hiring an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative (Business Development Associate) for a nationwide, field-based travel role. If you're a recent college graduate or early-career professional who wants to break into healthcare sales, this role gives you structured sales training, mentorship from senior sales leaders, and a clear path to a full closing role.

No medical sales experience required. We're looking for drive, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

At Skilled Wound Care, we don't just fill roles. We build partnerships, and our culture is the foundation of everything we do. You'll join a team that pushes each other to grow, shows up for one another, and shares in each other's wins. We work hard, we have fun doing it, and we believe a great culture isn't a perk. It's how we operate every day.

### **Why Start Your Healthcare Sales Career at Skilled Wound Care?**

* **Competitive entry-level pay:** a $73,000 base salary plus bonus potential that grows as you start closing accounts.
* **Mentorship from senior sales leaders:** you're never alone. Your challenges become our challenges, and your wins become our wins.
* **Clear career path:** we develop leaders from within, and many of our senior closers started right where you are.
* **Your voice matters:** your ideas carry weight, and you help build the vision, not just carry it out.
* **Integrity-first sales culture:** no shortcuts and no pressure tactics. We win the right way.
* **Full sales cycle exposure:** hands-on experience in B2B healthcare sales within the Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) industry.

### **What You'll Do as a Business Development Associate**

* **Prospecting and sales support:** learn and help with prospecting, outreach, lead generation, and relationship-building with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities nationwide, working alongside experienced closers.
* **Territory development:** help identify target accounts and learn how territory management and national market expansion strategy come together in the field.
* **Consultative and clinical value selling:** learn to explain the ROI of our physician-led wound care model to facility administrators, owners, and other decision-makers. Training and coaching are provided.
* **Relationship management:** build your own professional network with SNF staff, facility owners, and regional directors, mentored by senior team members.
* **Team collaboration:** share field insights, ask questions, and contribute to a team sales strategy that lifts everyone.

### **About the Travel: A True Road Warrior Role**

This is a **field-based medical sales role with extensive nationwide travel**. Expect to be on the road **4–5 days per week, including overnight stays**, visiting Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities in markets across the United States.

This role is a great fit if you:

* Enjoy being in the field, face-to-face with customers, rather than behind a desk
* Like a fast-paced schedule where every week looks different
* Are comfortable spending most weeknights away from home in hotels
* Want accelerated, hands-on experience across multiple healthcare markets nationwide

We're upfront about the travel because the right person will thrive on it, and it's one of the fastest ways to build your skills, your network, and your earning potential in healthcare sales.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required (business, marketing, communications, health sciences, or related fields encouraged)
* 0–2 years of experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, retail, or a related field. **Recent college graduates and internship experience are welcome.**
* Strong interest in healthcare, medical sales, or business development
* Team-first mindset, coachability, and the drive to learn and grow independently
* Willingness to travel extensively nationwide: 4–5 days per week with frequent overnight stays
* Valid U.S. driver's license
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $73,000
* **Bonus potential:** earn more as you begin closing accounts, with no ceiling as you grow into a full closing role
* Weekly education and leadership development
* Direct mentorship from senior sales leaders
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) and life insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)

### **Apply Today**

If you're eager to learn, ready for life on the road, and want a team that will invest in your growth from day one, **apply now** to join Skilled Wound Care as an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative.

*Skilled Wound Care is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, or genetic information.*
